deadline.value: The catalog gives no department deadline for this PhD; the Graduate School priority date for international Fall applicants is March 1.
deadline.quote: International Student Priority: March 1 Priority: August 1 $75 Secondary: April 30 Secondary: September 30 $135

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: The biomedical engineering PhD lists GRE scores among its application requirements.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores | Three letters of recommendation

supervisor.value: Admission does not require a faculty agreement; an advisor is chosen after admission, before 12 PhD credit hours.
supervisor.quote: Before completing 12 PhD credit hours, a student must select an advisor and an advisory committee.

funding.value: The catalog gives no funding rule for this PhD; the Graduate School's assistantship range is not a per-student guarantee.
funding.quote: assistantships for 20 hours of work per week for a nine-month period range from $5,800 to $25,000

entry_route.value: Applicants can be admitted from an undergraduate degree (minimum GPA 3.500) or from a master's degree (minimum GPA 3.250).
entry_route.quote: For students admitted from an undergraduate degree | For students admitted from a master's degree

notes: The catalog's English rule for this PhD covers international applicants who did not study at an English-speaking university and does not name India. Department web pages are blocked.
